firorize.title: Firorize
firorize.config.subtitle.profiles: Activate profiles to apply them in-world, and drag to reorder which one takes priority. Browse premade and community profiles or share your own colourful profiles!
firorize.config.searchHeader.block: Customise fire based on the %s beneath it
firorize.config.searchHeader.tag: Customise based on the %s of the block beneath it
firorize.config.searchHeader.biome: Customise fire based on the %s it's in
firorize.config.newProfile.prompt: What should this profile recolour by?
firorize.config.newProfile.description: Fire colour can be customised by the block, the biome, or the block tag of the block the fire is on. Choose which one this profile uses.
firorize.config.newProfile.tip.block: Recolour fire by the exact block it sits on (e.g. soul sand).
firorize.config.newProfile.tip.tag: Recolour fire by a tag of the block beneath it — a whole group of blocks at once (e.g. all logs).
firorize.config.newProfile.tip.biome: Recolour fire by the biome it's burning in (e.g. the Nether).
firorize.config.tooltip.profileFromCurre: Create a duplicate of the currently selected profile
firorize.config.tooltip.profileFromNewBu: Create a new profile from the default
firorize.config.tooltip.shareProfileButt: Share this profile online or send it to other players
firorize.config.tooltip.priorityArrow: Change the priority order of these tabs for if two colors clash on the same block
firorize.config.tooltip.movableButton: You must be loaded in a world to access this tab
firorize.config.tooltip.resetProfileButt: Reset this fire profile to default
firorize.config.tooltip.baseToggle: Edit the base color of the fire
firorize.config.tooltip.overlayToggle: Edit the overlay color of the fire
firorize.config.tooltip.applyButton: Apply the current fire color to the selected
firorize.config.tooltip.addColorPresetBu: Save the current fire color as a preset
firorize.config.tooltip.profileActive: Profile applied to fire — click to deactivate.
firorize.config.tooltip.profileInactive: Profile not applied — click to activate.
firorize.config.tooltip.badge.block: This profile recolours fire by the block the fire is on.
firorize.config.tooltip.badge.tag: This profile recolours fire by the block tag of the block underneath it.
firorize.config.tooltip.badge.biome: This profile recolours fire by the biome it is in.
firorize.config.confirm.deleteProfile.me: Are you sure you want to delete this profile? This cannot be undone.
firorize.config.tooltip.onlinePresets: Browse and import community fire profiles
firorize.config.tooltip.inboxButton: Profiles other players have sent you
firorize.config.tooltip.reorderProfilesB: Reorder profiles — drag to set which active profile wins
firorize.config.status.noPresets: No presets have been shared yet.
firorize.config.status.noBiomesNoWorld: Join a world to choose biomes — they aren't available from the main menu.
firorize.config.status.noTagsNoWorld: Join a world to choose block tags — they aren't available from the main menu.
firorize.config.tooltip.builtinProfiles: Browse and import built-in fire profiles
firorize.config.label.inboxDescription: Profiles other players have sent you, plus ones you've sent that are still pending.
firorize.config.status.signIn: Sign in to a Minecraft account to do this.
firorize.config.status.invalidTitle: Title: letters, numbers and spaces only.
firorize.config.status.tooLong: Title or description is too long.
firorize.config.status.rateLimited: Too many requests. Slow down a moment.
firorize.config.status.duplicateTitle: A profile with that name already exists online.
firorize.donate.popup.title: Enjoying Firorize?
firorize.donate.popup.body: Firorize is free, always. If it's brought some colour to your game, consider supporting it on Ko-fi!
